breakdown.description: For curved flow, pressure is higher on the outside of the turn to provide the required centripetal force; stating pressure increases toward the center reverses the correct direction of the pressure gradient.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the core physical misconception. The original prompt incorrectly stated that 'pressure increases toward the center of curvature'. The ground truth corrects this by implying the opposite (pressure is higher on the outside). The agent's generated specification explicitly repeated the user's error by stating, 'The pressure increases toward the center of curvature, so the inner side has higher pressure than the outer side.'
